subject.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests

question: Should OpenRouter music generation honor the existing explicit `models.providers.openrouter.request.allowPrivateNetwork` opt-in while video remains a deny-private exception?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and default-deny, but it intentionally expands an operator-controlled network capability to a newly introduced provider path, and sibling media behavior is not uniform.

options.title: Honor the music opt-in
options.body: Merge this implementation so music follows the established sanitized provider request-policy contract while capability-specific stricter exceptions remain explicit.

options.title: Keep music deny-private
options.body: Preserve the explicit false override while forwarding only headers, authentication, proxy, and TLS request settings.

recommendation.title: Honor the music opt-in
recommendation.body: Merge this implementation so music follows the established sanitized provider request-policy contract while capability-specific stricter exceptions remain explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the current OpenRouter music request path, so they are the strongest available owner for its intended capability boundary.
